en: Black‑and‑white street scene of a historic European square with cobblestones and a striped pedestrian crossing in the foreground. Pigeons walk on the ground while pedestrians and a cyclist cross the square. At the center stands a large baroque fountain topped by a trident‑holding figure (Neptune). Around the square are several multistory buildings with arcades, painted facades and shutters; one has the word "ALBERGO" at street level and another on the right has a domed roof decorated with patterned tiles.
